title: How a Jewish Sect Became Rome's Religion
dek: Of how the empire that crucified a Galilean preacher ended, 350 years later, by making his church its only lawful faith.

panels.label: Church Tells It
panels.text: The faith spread by the witness of martyrs, and God gave Constantine a sign of victory in the cross.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: The church grew into an organized network that persecution could not break, and emperors in civil wars found it worth winning.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 10 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Jerusalem to Thessalonica.
